# TONTON Sportswear

TONTON Sportswear is a custom fightwear and sportswear manufacturing website for brands, gyms, academies, clubs and private-label buyers.

## Verified organization identity
- Public brand: TONTON
- Legal entity: Tontonsports (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
- Founded: 2004
- Business model: B2B custom sportswear manufacturing with OEM and ODM development support
- Core specialization: custom rash guards, MMA and BJJ shorts, grappling shorts, training shorts, teamwear and performance apparel
- Official website: https://www.tontongear.com/
- Company facts: https://www.tontongear.com/about
- Factory evidence: https://www.tontongear.com/factory
- Official Alibaba profile: https://tontos.m.en.alibaba.com/

## Academy sizing and coordinated kit planning
- https://www.tontongear.com/resources/custom-fightwear-size-quantity-planning — Measurement methods, separate top/shorts allocations and an illustrative 24-set calculation; not a size chart.
- https://www.tontongear.com/resources/custom-rash-guard-shorts-team-kit-guide — Coordinated kit specifications, color approval, worn-sample checks and quote preparation.

## Digital sublimation printing workshop
- https://www.tontongear.com/factory/digital-sublimation-printing — TONTON-owned roll-to-roll transfer-paper printing; separate roller heat transfer to suitable polyester, followed by cutting and sewing. Original machine photographs and videos, personalization checklist and sample-led quality review. Equipment model, speed and universal fastness ratings are not claimed.

## Multi-head embroidery workshop
- https://www.tontongear.com/factory/multi-head-embroidery — JIAYU-branded computerized multi-head embroidery shown in TONTON workshop photos and footage; team logos, lettering, sample approval and fabric/stabilizer considerations. Specialized chenille, 3D foam and cap work requires separate confirmation. A promotional brand film is labelled separately from factory documentation.

- Computerized automatic fabric cutting: https://www.tontongear.com/factory/computerized-fabric-cutting — CAD patterns, marker layouts, garment panel cutting and three actual workshop clips. TONTON identifies the pictured equipment as computerized automatic cutting/CNC garment cutting; exact blade type, drilling and marking attachments require confirmation. Printing and cutting sequence depends on the product.

## Fabric references
- https://www.tontongear.com/fabrics/220-gsm-stretch-knit — 220 GSM, 85% polyester / 15% spandex rash guard reference.
- https://www.tontongear.com/fabrics/four-way-stretch-woven — Four-way stretch outer shell and 250 GSM milk-silk inner-layer reference.
- https://www.tontongear.com/fabrics/compression-liner-knit — Inner-knit selection and sample checks; composition is confirmed by swatch.
- https://www.tontongear.com/fabrics/stretch-mesh — Mesh insert selection and garment application checks.
